problem:
An inner product on $V={R}^{3}$ is given by $⟨x,y⟩=6{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+6{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+{x}_{3}{y}_{3}.$ Find $⟨x,y⟩$, if

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,y=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
Computing the inner product according to the definition, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨x,y⟩ & =6{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+6{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+{x}_{3}{y}_{3} \\  & =6\cdot 1\cdot 2+6\cdot 3\cdot 1+4\cdot (-2) \\  & =12+18-8 \\  & =22.\end{aligned}
$$
